description: raw-recurrence-v3 plus the declared, held view operator stage (view_operator, its gate view_gate; the recurrence stage then also requires the gate). Shared by every line. History: recipes/HISTORY.md.

view_operator.admission: held: the view-ask corpus awaits the owner's licence review (VIEW_CORPUS.md section 6) and each student's exact-weight runtime qualification precedes this stage; the stage runs only when this declaration admits it
view_operator.decision: DECISIONS.md 2026-10-09 'one summarizer family: view and ask'; TRAINING_RECIPE.md 'The view operator stage'

corpus.conversion: natlang_neuralese.data.view_records (view-ask port records -> trajectory-trainer records with one view part; validation split kept with the corpus)

view_operator.after: each student's exact-weight runtime qualification (adapted_runtime) on the text warm-up's weights; the recurrence stage (recurrence_warmup) requires this stage's gate

objectives.reconstruct: reader CE of the value from its faithful view (view(x): parts marked faithful, no instructions)
objectives.consume: reader CE of the dataset's answer, summary or the code-computed fact with the source withheld (the prompt shows only the block written for the purpose)
objectives.compare: purpose sensitivity: purpose_contrast hinge (weight 0.25, margin 0.1 nats/token) against the same value viewed for a partner purpose (view_stage.contrast_instructions)
objectives.distill: self-distillation (weight 1.0) from the full-text reader: the crisp rendering shows the whole value (the part's preview is the value)
objectives.length: every write within the port's block bound (max_write_vectors 512; values chunked at the view site so each chunk's write fits: train.trajectories.view_write_plan); single and chunk writes teacher-forced to ceil(tokens / 4) vectors (view_tokens_per_vector 4; the stop head learns the boundary, stop_weight); the combining write of a chunked value is the stop head's choice, trained by policy gradient with a length cost of 0.01 nats per vector (stop_pg). At inference the stop head decides.

gate.stage: view_gate (eval/view_gate.py on the view stage's recurrence checkpoint and its trained soft view body)
metrics: reconstruction recovery per artifact type, with its compression ratio (value tokens per vector)
QA recovery: target CE with the block vs the full text vs none, per artifact type
correct vs shuffled block margin per artifact type
purpose sensitivity: CE with a partner-purpose block minus CE with the own-purpose block
pi next-action CE on held harness-bench v3 records: view blocks vs crisp previews vs full outputs
gate.thresholds: proposed (the stage's parameters); the owner confirms them before admission

open: a smoke of this stage on a small slice for both lines (trainer options were added for it: faithful parts, purpose_contrast, stop_pg in the handler)

recurrence_warmup starts from the text warm-up's weights, not this stage's: carrying the view stage's weights forward needs a declared continuation (the trajectory trainer's --continue-from requires identical data)

recurrence.view_length: written views sized ceil(tokens / 4) per write within the port's block bound (values chunked at the view site to fit: train.trajectories.view_write_plan); the notes keep tokens_per_vector 1. backward_policy auto resolves to joint when views are written (train.trajectories), so the stage's auto declaration stays valid.
